import re, struct, zlib, math, sys

def parse(path):
    moves=[]  # (x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,e_positive, obj)
    x=y=z=0.0
    e=0.0
    obj=None
    for line in open(path):
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('M486 S'):
            try: obj=int(s.split('S',1)[1])
            except: pass
            continue
        if not (s.startswith('G1') or s.startswith('G0')): continue
        nx,ny,nz,ne=x,y,z,e
        for ax in 'XYZ':
            m=re.search(r'\b'+ax+r'(-?[\d.]+)',s)
            if m:
                v=float(m.group(1))
                if ax=='X': nx=v
                elif ax=='Y': ny=v
                else: nz=v
        m=re.search(r'\bE(-?[\d.]+)',s)
        if m: ne=float(m.group(1))
        moves.append((x,y,z,nx,ny,nz,ne>0,obj))
        x,y,z,e=nx,ny,nz,ne
    return moves

def render_png(moves, proj, out, W=1200, pad=10, color=True, cmap_min=None, cmap_max=None):
    pts=[]
    for (x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,ext,obj) in moves:
        if not ext: continue
        a=proj(x0,y0,z0); b=proj(x1,y1,z1)
        pts.append((a,b,obj))
    if not pts:
        print('no points'); return
    xs=[p[0][0] for p in pts]+[p[1][0] for p in pts]
    ys=[p[0][1] for p in pts]+[p[1][1] for p in pts]
    minx,maxx=min(xs),max(xs); miny,maxy=min(ys),max(ys)
    dx=max(maxx-minx,1e-9); dy=max(maxy-miny,1e-9)
    # keep aspect
    sc=min((W-2*pad)/dx,(W-2*pad)/dy)
    H=int(dy*sc)+2*pad
    img=[[(255,255,255) for _ in range(W)] for _ in range(H)]
    def px(p):
        return (pad+(p[0]-minx)*sc, H-1-(pad+(p[1]-miny)*sc))
    # draw segments with Bresenham-ish thick line
    def line(p0,p1,col):
        x0,y0=px(p0); x1,y1=px(p1)
        n=max(2,int(max(abs(x1-x0),abs(y1-y0)))+1)
        for i in range(n+1):
            t=i/n
            xx=int(round(x0+(x1-x0)*t)); yy=int(round(y0+(y1-y0)*t))
            for ox in (-1,0,1):
                for oy in (-1,0,1):
                    X=xx+ox; Y=yy+oy
                    if 0<=X<W and 0<=Y<H: img[Y][X]=col
    colors=[(220,20,60),(30,90,220),(20,140,60),(200,120,0),(120,20,160),(0,150,160),(150,60,60),(60,60,60)]
    for a,b,obj in pts:
        line(a,b,colors[(obj if obj is not None else 7)%len(colors)])
    raw=b''
    for row in img:
        raw+=b'\x00'+b''.join(bytes(c) for c in row)
    def chunk(t,d):
        return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',W,H,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(out,'wb').write(png)
    print('wrote',out,W,'x',H,'range x',minx,maxx,'y',miny,maxy)

if __name__=='__main__':
    moves=parse('/app/text.gcode')
    # top view all objects, color by obj
    render_png(moves, lambda x,y,z:(x,y),'/app/work/topall.png',W=1200)

import re, math
from raster import parse

moves=parse('/app/text.gcode')
def centroid_cov(pts):
    n=len(pts)
    cx=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/n; cy=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/n; cz=sum(p[2] for p in pts)/n
    C=[[0.0]*3 for _ in range(3)]
    for x,y,z in pts:
        d=[x-cx,y-cy,z-cz]
        for i in range(3):
            for j in range(3):
                C[i][j]+=d[i]*d[j]
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(3): C[i][j]/=n
    return (cx,cy,cz),C

def jacobi(A):
    A=[row[:] for row in A]
    V=[[1.0 if i==j else 0.0 for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
    for _ in range(100):
        # find largest off-diagonal
        p,q=0,1; mx=abs(A[0][1])
        for i in range(3):
            for j in range(i+1,3):
                if abs(A[i][j])>mx: mx=abs(A[i][j]); p,q=i,j
        if mx<1e-12: break
        app,aqq,apq=A[p][p],A[q][q],A[p][q]
        theta=(aqq-app)/(2*apq)
        t=(1 if theta>=0 else -1)/(abs(theta)+math.sqrt(theta*theta+1))
        c=1/math.sqrt(t*t+1); s=t*c
        # rotate
        for k in range(3):
            if k!=p and k!=q:
                akp,akq=A[k][p],A[k][q]
                A[k][p]=A[p][k]=c*akp-s*akq
                A[k][q]=A[q][k]=s*akp+c*akq
        A[p][p]=c*c*app-2*s*c*apq+s*s*aqq
        A[q][q]=s*s*app+2*s*c*apq+c*c*aqq
        A[p][q]=A[q][p]=0.0
        for k in range(3):
            vkp,vkq=V[k][p],V[k][q]
            V[k][p]=c*vkp-s*vkq
            V[k][q]=s*vkp+c*vkq
    vals=[A[i][i] for i in range(3)]
    vecs=[[V[r][c] for r in range(3)] for c in range(3)]
    return vals,vecs

if __name__=='__main__':
    pts=[]
    for (x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,ext,obj) in moves:
        if ext and obj==0:
            pts.append((x0,y0,z0)); pts.append((x1,y1,z1))
    print('pts',len(pts))
    c,C=centroid_cov(pts)
    print('centroid',c)
    vals,vecs=jacobi(C)
    order=sorted(range(3),key=lambda i:vals[i])
    print('eigenvalues',[vals[i] for i in order])
    for i in order:
        print('vec',vecs[i],'val',vals[i])
    # plane normal = smallest
    n=vecs[order[0]]
    in1=vecs[order[2]]  # largest
    in2=vecs[order[1]]
    # choose vertical = in-plane with larger |z|
    if abs(in1[2])>=abs(in2[2]):
        vert=in1; horiz=in2
    else:
        vert=in2; horiz=in1
    # ensure vert points up
    if vert[2]<0: vert=[-v for v in vert]
    print('normal',n,'vert',vert,'horiz',horiz)
    # project and save points
    import json
    proj=[]
    for p in pts:
        d=[p[i]-c[i] for i in range(3)]
        proj.append((sum(d[i]*horiz[i] for i in range(3)), sum(d[i]*vert[i] for i in range(3)), sum(d[i]*n[i] for i in range(3))))
    json.dump(proj,open('/app/work/proj.json','w'))
    xs=[p[0] for p in proj]; ys=[p[1] for p in proj]; zs=[p[2] for p in proj]
    print('proj ranges h',min(xs),max(xs),'v',min(ys),max(ys),'n',min(zs),max(zs))
